scope: RGBA review boards for qi projectile art and ordinary/empowered contact key poses.

assets.prompt: Edit the transparent Đại Lực Kim Cương Chưởng video game pixel-art source board. Keep the exact positions and scale relationships of its two saffron chibi Shaolin monks on the left and the four projectile silhouettes on the right: ordinary upper row has three small open palms at staircase offsets, upper one furthest right and lower one closest; empowered lower row has a single much larger open palm. Redesign only the four projectiles so that they are a GHOSTLY HAND-SHAPED VORTEX MADE OF MOVING QI. Each silhouette remains recognizable as an open hand, four fingers and a thumb, but the interior is mainly near-transparent dark amber mist and empty alpha, interwoven with thin swirling curved pale gold and ivory filaments. Several separate curling streams trace fingertips and curl inward into the palm vortex; the outer luminous contour breaks into tiny detached embers in places, and the wrist disintegrates into a very short wispy gold wake. Make it look like flowing breath concentrated into hand geometry, not a physical hand with a glow. No solid fill, skin, fingernails, realistic knuckles, metal texture, cartoon glove, thick dark outline, or long streak. Tightly confined glow, real transparent alpha, sparse compact stepped pixel highlights, orthographic 3/4 game view, no background, captions, or dividers.

Create a NEW transparent landscape 3-column by 2-row VFX keyframe board for the hit of this Shaolin palm-shaped qi projectile, facing right in elevated orthographic 3/4 pixel-art wuxia RPG view. Reference image supplies only golden school palette and recognizable open-hand silhouette. Do not copy its opaque gold hands or include monks. All six cels are effects only, no scenery. Each row depicts sequential stages of one collision at the SAME centered local impact anchor, with wide clear alpha gutters. TOP ROW ordinary palm, three cels: (1) on contact a compact ivory spark at the leading/right edge of a faint spectral gold hand imprint collapsing inward; (2) small burst of curved gold qi filaments splaying outward from that center, with a narrow shallow elliptical floor ripple below it; (3) collapsing thin wisps and 3–5 fading motes. BOTTOM ROW empowered palm, three cels: (1) larger but tight yellow-white contact flare where the big spectral hand hits, the thumb and fingers only broken translucent traces; (2) strong amber pressure burst with two broken concentric elliptical ripples near the ground, a few chunky pixel sparks and gold ribbons bursting right and curling outward; (3) the rings break into sparse drifting embers and translucent curls. Ground ellipses use the elevated RPG perspective; no solid ground, no crater, no smoke wall and no pasted star icon. High-contrast handcrafted pixel clusters and true alpha. Keep the empowered row visibly broader than the ordinary row and still tightly centered on the same contact point in each cel. No borders, words, characters, checkerboard or full backdrop.
